name: Manchester Packaging Co
old_description: Founded in 1969, Manchester Packaging Company began business with the goal of providing our customers with quality economical packaging and we continue that tradition today.
about:
Manchester Packaging Company was founded in 1969 in St. James, Missouri, with the goal of providing quality economical packaging. The company remains a custom manufacturer of polyethylene blown film and bags.

The company produces mono-layer and three-layer co-extruded polyethylene film in various slip and clarity grades, including biopolymer blends. It offers flexographic printing from one to eight colors in line or process designs, with both surface and reverse printing options. Finished products include side-seal and bottom-seal bags made to custom sizes, as well as US Postal Service mail overwraps. The facility also recycles 99 percent of its production waste.

Manchester Packaging serves manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, and retail businesses across the packaging sector. Its FDA-approved film is used in applications requiring direct food contact, though specific end markets are not detailed.

The business was started to deliver economical packaging without sacrificing quality, a tradition it says it continues today. Its differentiation rests on in-house extrusion, printing, and converting capabilities that allow custom film and bag constructions within equipment limits.
